final:
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("../secret.txt") == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(name) else ""

count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  pre names.len() >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret.txt", "/etc/passwd"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      let content = fs.read(name) else continue
      n += 1
  n
